name: Archer arrows
notes: Arrow types an archer can fletch and fire (ADR-0004: learned from fletching schematics; chain Rope Arrow → Line Shot → Haul Shot). Seeded with the archer's signature Rope Arrow (mw-e19.4), whose flight and rope are src/content/data/arrow/rope.json (mw-e05.10). Trick-shot techniques (pinning chain) are taught by Master Ewan Rooke at the Bridgeward College (mw-ju8.13).

capabilities.name: Rope Arrow
capabilities.description: Loose an arrow into soft wood or earth that anchors a climbable rope (ADR-0004 rope chain, step 1). An archer signature: never shared.

capabilities.name: Pinning Shot
capabilities.description: Pin a creature or cloth to a wall with an arrow (ADR-0004 pinning chain, step 1).

capabilities.name: Ricochet Shot
capabilities.description: Bank an arrow off stone to reach around cover (ADR-0004 pinning chain, step 2).

capabilities.name: Severing Shot
capabilities.description: Cut a strap with an arrow to drop a shield, a lantern or a cargo net (ADR-0004 pinning chain, step 3).
